timebase: Encoded video currentTime in seconds; unchanged by browser playbackRate.
method: Caption OCR from every encoded frame. The visible decision number indexes chronological PICK events; its accepted STEP batch supplies the actual recorded command. This is command intent, not physical input telemetry.
control_semantics: Keys/buttons show requested controls within the active command batch, not held state, execution duration, click count, or applied mouse motion. Only explicit move keys, sneak-on, slot/inventory selection, hit/use, and explicit click buttons are mapped. High-level fight/bridge/mine/place/craft actions remain named; look values are requested degrees, not mouse deltas. No state is carried between commands.
